text:
laura: heads up / brief thread - proposing an emergency JIT RBAC path for HSM ops to allow time-limited rewraps for BYOK during vuln windows. want quick feedback before i open a PR.

chris: absolutely JIT. must require approver + MFA + explicit TTL. all actions audited and exported. no plaintext key ever.

anil: implementation sketch: ephemeral operator creds bound to an HSM attestation token and session id. policy snippet (pseudocode) to limit actions and TTL.

jess: oncall perspective: keep steps simple. pre-authorized approvers list (sec-lead, legal-oncall) + executor role for ops. suggest CLI `rw key rewrap --cust <id> --key <id> --to <ver>` to reduce errors. 30m approval SLA for P0 sounds ok if SRE agrees.

maya: legal: different customers have different contractual requirements. regulated tenants require documented chain-of-custody and evidence bundles. retention should be configurable per-tenant. will own contract mapping.

ben: vuln triage: classify CVE actions (reboot-only, patch, rewrap). do 2-canary rewraps on low-risk tenants, monitor, then batch. create a CVE->mitigation mapping.

laura: ops Qs: 1) can we stream operator audit events to an immutable central store and optionally forward signed subset to customers? 2) what should be in the evidence bundle?

chris: (1) yes - central WORM S3 with object locks + signed manifests. forwarding via mTLS and only signed metadata (no key material). (2) minimal evidence fields: operator id, approver chain, session id, HSM attestation blob (base64), pre/post key hashes (sha256), CLI args, request id, result, timestamps, human summary. add signature + hash chain for tamper evidence.

anil: sample CLI capture to include in bundle: `REQUEST_ID=2026-06-15T03:12:11Z-6f9a; APPROVER=chris; OPERATOR=jess; SESSION_ID=sess-0a1b2c; HSM_ATTEST=attest_blob_base64; PRE_KEY_HASH=sha256:aa34...; POST_KEY_HASH=sha256:bb77...; RESULT=SUCCESS`. store signed approver assertion and attestation blob.

audit-bot: notice: scheduled HSM firmware window 2026-06-18 02:00-04:00 UTC. will open canary plan ticket.

deploy-bot: created INC-20260615-19 for CVE-xxxx. assigned @ben @laura.

jess: ops note: rewraps can cause transient failures for in-flight sessions. plan a short auto-fallback to previous key version if error rate >0.5% for 5m. require non-prod rehearsal plus tabletop.

laura: action items: (A) draft RBAC PR with JIT + TTL + approver flow, (B) draft evidence JSON schema and CLI capture spec, (C) coordinate canary list with @ben, (D) schedule tabletop with legal + oncall. who will own per-tenant retention config?

maya: legal will own per-contract retention mapping and consent flags. i'll label tenants requiring notification before rewrap.

chris: security will review PR, define signing/encryption for bundles, and propose minimal retention durations for SOC2/PCI.

ben: i'll pick initial low-risk canaries and run rehearsal, will share dashboards + alerts.

laura: thanks all. PR incoming this afternoon. aim to signoff this week and run canary during patch window. :rocket:
